blue.webm is an original four-second silent blue frame generated for playback tests with FFmpeg: `ffmpeg -f lavfi -i color=c=blue:s=160x90:r=5:d=4 -an -c:v libvpx -b:v 30k blue.webm`. It contains no third-party media. Tests declare synthetic legal contexts solely to exercise decisions and rendering; the fixture is not an example of a real deepfake.

green.png is an original 160×90 solid RGB (24, 61, 51) PNG generated with Python zlib/struct for offline export tests. It contains no third-party imagery.
